description.content:
Get a list of all glossary terms objects. Results can be filtered or ordered by specific parameters.

**Required Role:** Viewer or higher

query.description: A comma separated list of collection guids, for to filter the collection items from

Specify the ordering for the results. 

 A comma separated list for ordering by multiple fields and a preceding `-` indicates reverse order. 

Note: Order is case-sensitive.
A comma separated list of user or team guids to filter for objects within these users as owners (technical or business).
A page number within the paginated result set.
Number of results to return per page.
Search for an asset using business owner name
Search for an asset using a collection name
A search term.
Search for an asset using its name
Search for an asset using a tag name
Search for an asset using technical owner name
A comma separated list of team guids to filter for tables owned by users of those teams.

Filter objects by updated_on. May specify __gt, __gte, __lt or __lte.

 API call to: 

 ENDPOINT/updated_on__gt=2021-08-04T15:12:40&updated_on__lt=2021-08-23 

 will result with objects updated_on after  August 4th 2021 at 15:12:40, but before August 23rd 2021. 

. If you want to include lower or upper bound of the range use __gte or __lte respectively.
